This suggests that the compound may act as a modulator of the sialyltransferase enzyme, potentially influencing the synthesis of sialic acid. The sialyltransferase enzyme, in turn, is involved in the modification of glycoproteins and glycolipids, which could have downstream effects on cellular processes. The evidence is consistent with a mechanism involving enzyme inhibition or modulation, but the exact nature of the interaction remains to be fully elucidated.
